Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Shashank Shekhar, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ram Sevak Choudhary, App

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Partha Sarthy
 Oral Order
5 20-01-2023

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner has preferred this application for grant of regular bail in a case registered under sections 419, 420, 468, 471 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

As per the prosecution case, at the competitive examinations being conducted for appointment in the police service, it is stated that one Pankaj Kumar was found giving examination in place of the petitioner.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that neither the petitioner was arrested at the spot nor any incriminating article recovered from his possession.
The person caught giving examination in his place has been enlarged on bail vide order contained in Annexure 2.
The petitioner is in Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.33944 of 2022(5) dt.20-01-2023 custody since 2.6.2022 and charge sheet has been submitted in the case.
Heard learned APP for the State.
